findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_land_property, get_land_valuation, get_land_activity, get_my_account · Private data: search_land, get_land_property, get_fabrica_lending_market, get_fabrica_loan_book, get_land_portfolio, get_fabrica_stats, get_land_trust_documents, get_land_activity, get_land_order_book, get_land_portfolio_map_image, ask_fabrica, find_us_parcel, contact_fabrica_support, make_land_offer, list_land_for_sale, accept_land_offer, buy_land, cancel_land_order, borrow_against_land, repay_loan_against_land, transfer_land, update_trust_agreement, update_land_description, update_land_photos, deposit_to_lending_pool, withdraw_from_lending_pool, get_my_account, get_my_properties, get_my_offers, get_my_loans, what_needs_attention, get_my_properties_being_added · Public sink: contact_fabrica_support, list_land_for_sale, update_trust_agreement, deposit_to_lending_pool, get_my_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_land_property, get_land_valuation, get_land_activity, get_my_account · Private data: search_land, get_land_property, get_fabrica_lending_market, get_fabrica_loan_book, get_land_portfolio, get_fabrica_stats, get_land_trust_documents, get_land_activity, get_land_order_book, get_land_portfolio_map_image, ask_fabrica, find_us_parcel, contact_fabrica_support, make_land_offer, list_land_for_sale, accept_land_offer, buy_land, cancel_land_order, borrow_against_land, repay_loan_against_land, transfer_land, update_trust_agreement, update_land_description, update_land_photos, deposit_to_lending_pool, withdraw_from_lending_pool, get_my_account, get_my_properties, get_my_offers, get_my_loans, what_needs_attention, get_my_properties_being_added · Public sink: contact_fabrica_support, list_land_for_sale, update_trust_agreement, deposit_to_lending_pool, get_my_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
